Operations Specialist - Mandarin Speaker (m/f/d) About J&T Express

J&T Express is a fast-growing global logistics company with a strong focus on e-commerce and last-mile delivery.

With operations across Asia and rapidly expanding across Europe, we are building scalable operations and strong customer experience standards in Germany.

Behind every smooth delivery is a well-structured operation. And behind that, people who understand processes, data, and quality.

If you enjoy bringing structure into complexity, improving service quality, and working closely with different stakeholders - this role might be a strong fit.

Your Responsibilities

- Act as a key interface to BPO partners and support daily operational communication
- Support business volume forecasting and assist in operational planning
- Monitor service quality through call and chat audits (e.g. communication style, issue handling, documentation)
- Identify improvement areas based on data and operational insights
- Support the development and delivery of trainings for operational teams
- Create and maintain training materials, guidelines, and assessments
- Train stakeholders on internal systems and processes

Your Profile

- First experience in operations, customer service, BPO environments, or similar fields
- Strong analytical mindset and confidence in working with data
- Good understanding of operational processes and service quality management
- Experience in training, coaching, or creating training materials is a plus
- Comfortable working with common office tools and data analysis tools
- Strong communication skills and structured way of working
- Fluent in Mandarin & English, German is a plus

What You Can Expect

- A role with real impact on service quality and operational excellence
- The opportunity to shape processes in a growing international environment
- Close collaboration with cross-functional and international teams
- A dynamic setup where ideas are welcomed and improvements are visible

Sounds exciting? Then we look forward to getting to know you!

If you have any questions regarding the role, you can reach out via: de-hr@jtexpress.de

HR Business Partner (m/f/d) About J&T Express

Join J&T Express at one of the most exciting stages of our growth journey. As we continue to scale rapidly across Germany and Europe, you'll help shape our people strategy, influence key business decisions, and grow alongside one of the world's fastest-growing logistics companies.

J&T Express is one of the fastest-growing international logistics companies, operating in multiple countries across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and Latin America. As we continue our rapid expansion in Germany, we are building scalable structures, empowering our people, and creating exciting opportunities for those who want to make a real impact from day one.

The role is currently based in Kelsterbach. As part of our continued growth, we are planning to relocate our office to Nieder-Olm, near Mainz, around October 2026.

Your Responsibilities

- Act as a trusted HR Business Partner for managers and employees throughout the entire employee lifecycle
- Advise leaders on all operational HR matters, employee relations, and labor law topics
- Manage onboarding, employee development, performance-related topics, and offboarding processes
- Ensure compliance with German labor law and support topics such as contractor management, employee leasing (ANÜ), and HR governance
- Drive HR projects and continuously improve HR processes and structures
- Support administrative HR activities where needed while maintaining a strong business partnering focus
- Work closely with internal stakeholders in a dynamic international environment and actively contribute to building scalable HR structures

Your Profile

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field
- Minimum of 4-5 years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager, or in a comparable generalist HR role
- Solid knowledge of German labor law and HR compliance, including topics such as employee leasing, temporary workforce management, and contractor agreements
- Experience supporting managers throughout the entire employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding
- Strong stakeholder management and the confidence to advise managers on operational and strategic HR topics
- Tech-savvy with an interest in digital HR processes and continuous process improvement
- Fluent in German and English, Chinese is a plus
- Experience in a fast-paced operational environment is a strong plus
- Hands-on mindset, strong sense of ownership, and the ability to thrive in a rapidly growing international organization

What we offer

- The opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing international logistics companies
- A key role with high visibility and the chance to shape HR in a rapidly scaling organization
- A dynamic, international, and multicultural working environment with fast decision-making processes
- High levels of ownership, autonomy, and excellent development opportunities
- Competitive compensation, bonus programs, and additional employee benefits

Ready to shape the future with us?

We move Jet-fast, deliver Timely, and grow with Technology. Join J&T Express and become part of one of the fastest-growing logistics companies in the world. We look forward to receiving your application!

If you're excited about this opportunity, we'd be delighted to receive your application.
Apply via this platform or send your CV directly to:

Alexandros Strantzalis
Recruitment Specialist - J&T Express Germany

jobs.occupation: Technician / Engineer Commissioning (m/f/d) Special Purpose Machinery (Inbetriebnahmetechniker/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About ficonTEC:

ficonTEC Service GmbH is an innovative high-tech company that has quickly established itself in a highly specialized market since 2001. With continuous growth and innovative development, we are a recognized market leader in the automated assembly and testing of optoelectronic components and (hybrid) photonic devices. Our company develops advanced solutions such as high-precision die bonding, fiber alignment, and laser soldering systems, which are critical for manufacturing cutting-edge photonic devices like LiDAR sensors, high-speed data transceivers, and silicon photonics. These technologies are paving the way for advancements in telecommunications, autonomous vehicles, and medical diagnostics.

Our company-wide goal is to set up top-notch technology that facilitates our customers from around the world in building tomorrow’s optoelectronic devices. We believe in equal opportunity, with employees committed to diversity and inclusion, offering a vibrant working environment.

Are you looking for a job in a forward-looking industry? Then become part of our strong and experienced team as a:

Would you like to commission state-of-the-art automation systems, solve technical challenges, and ensure that software and hardware work together seamlessly? Then join our team as:

Technician / Engineer Commissioning (m/f/d) Special Purpose Machinery

Your Challenge::
You bring our highly automated special-purpose machines to life.

From initial power-up to final customer acceptance, you will take technical responsibility for commissioning our systems and ensure seamless interaction between hardware and software. Working with state-of-the-art motion control, vision, and automation technologies, you will ensure that all machine functions operate reliably, safely, and in accordance with technical specifications.

You will analyze complex technical systems, solve electrical and mechanical challenges, and support each machine through to the next project phase

Your responsibilities:

- Commissioning and parameterization of I/O, vision, and motion control systems
- Configuration and adjustment of machine processes within our in-house control software (PCM)
- Initialization, testing, and optimization of machine functions
- Execution and verification of safety functions
- Electrical and mechanical troubleshooting of complex automation systems
- Analysis and resolution of hardware and software issues
- Performing software, functional, and system tests
- Ensuring machine performance in accordance with technical specifications
- Documentation of results and structured handover to subsequent project phase
What Makes This Role Exciting
You will experience firsthand how individual components are transformed into highly precise production systems used by leading technology companies worldwide.

From day one, you will take responsibility, work on sophisticated automation solutions, and see the direct impact of your work every day. Each successfully commissioned machine contributes directly to our customers' success and to the advancement of future-oriented technologies.
Your Profile::

- Successfully completed further training as a certified technician or master craftsman, or a degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a comparable field
- Ideally, initial professional experience in commissioning, automation technology, or special-purpose machinery
- Solid knowledge of electrical engineering, measurement and control technology, or drive systems
- Strong technical understanding of complex machinery and mechatronic systems
- Structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong analytical skills and enthusiasm for troubleshooting
- German and English language skills, both written and spoken (minimum level B2)

Your Benefits:

- Permanent employment contract
- Excellent long-term career prospects
- Flexible working hours
- Childcare subsidy for children up to the age of three
- Company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits
- Corporate fitness program
- Comprehensive onboarding program and individual support
- Annual employee development reviews with a focus on personal and professional growth
- Employee discount programs (e.g., City for Two, Benefits App)
- Regular company events, including summer parties, Christmas celebrations, and B2Run events

Interested? :
Become part of our team and help shape the next generation of highly automated production systems. 

We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV, cover letter, and relevant certificates. 

You can find out more about ficonTEC here: 
www.ficontec.com

ficonTEC Service GmbH

Rehland 8
28832 Achim

The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

Our offer

Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form:

https://bewerbermanagement.net/67hhg

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. TheGWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expresslyencouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail:

jancillie.louw@gwdg.de ).

jobs.occupation: Business Development Specialist - Biomonitoring (all genders) - BY, BW, NRW (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

Microbiological contamination control is at the heart of pharmaceutical manufacturing quality — and in this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding a cutting-edge portfolio of microbiological testing and automation solutions across key German markets. You will take full ownership of a defined territory, developing and executing a strategic account plan that targets new customer acquisition, deepens existing relationships, and positions the portfolio as the partner of choice within the pharmaceutical and biotech sector.

You will engage consultatively with technical and commercial stakeholders across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, guiding them through high-value capital investment decisions with clarity and credibility. By combining deep microbiological expertise with a structured approach to pipeline management, you will identify untapped market opportunities, introduce advanced automation and robotics solutions, and deliver measurable revenue growth. Your ability to navigate long sales cycles and translate technical value into business outcomes will be central to your success in this role.

Who you are:

- You bring at least 5 years of field sales experience in pharmaceutical quality control, production, or a closely related life science sector, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets in complex business-to-business environments.
- You hold academic degree in microbiology, biology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience); knowledge of laboratory automation or robotics is a strong advantage.
- You have in-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical quality control and production environments, including familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practice guidelines, Annex 1 and cleanroom or aseptic processing requirements.
- You are experienced in managing high-value, long-cycle capital expenditure sales processes, including stakeholder mapping across complex organizational structures and engagement at management level.
- You are fluent in German (C2) and English (C1); an established professional network within the German pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is highly advantageous.
- You hold a valid driver’s license and are willing to spend the majority of your working time in the field across Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, and North Rhine-Westphalia; candidates based within these regions are preferred.
- You demonstrate strong negotiation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage credibly across both technical and commercial functions.
- You have a proven ability to manage territory, spending over 70% of time in the field, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and you are highly self-directed and results-oriented, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and territory planning.
- You are familiar with artificial intelligence concepts and tools, including their practical applications and limitations, and are able to apply this understanding to evaluate and use AI-supported solutions responsibly in a commercial context.

Location

Germany (Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, North Rhine-Westphalia) | Field-based with regional travel

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Development Lead for the Helmholtz Cloud portal

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: 01.10.2026 | ID: FHMA020/2026 | Deadline: 02.09.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

In that capacity, DESY is member of the German Helmholtz Research Association, a group of 19 independent research centers all over Germany, providing a world-class science infrastructure, focusing on the major societal challenges of our time, covering areas like climate change, energy transition, transport in the future and the battle against severe and widespread diseases. In order to most efficiently use its distributed IT resources and expertise and at the same time reduce the energy footprint, the Association is operating the Helmholtz Federated Services, in short, HIFIS. The platform provides a seamless and powerful ICT infrastructure to the entire Helmholtz scientific community. Within HIFIS, DESY is responsible for the implementation of the central Cloud Portal, making firstclass distributed cloud services available and easily accessible to the 42 000 employees of all Helmholtz centres and, whenever possible, to external scientific collaboration partners.

About your role:

As a Scientist, you take the responsibility to lead the implementation and functional development of a Helmholtz-wide Cloud Portal.

- You will lead the implementation and further functional development of the novel Helmholtz-wide Cloud Portal, providing access to distributed compute data and other cloud services to all Helmholtz centres, their scientists and collaboration partners

- You will lead the evaluation and definition of necessary technical interfaces, in the areas of AAI, monitoring/accounting and resource management, to seamlessly integrate all cloud service offerings into the portal and make all services easily accessible
- You will be the contact of your team to other HIFIS groups and to groups outside of HIFIS, working on similar endeavors

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / Postdoc (m/f/d) in the field of Cryogenic Quantum Electronics (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
With around 15.000 students and 3.800 employees, the Technische Universität Braunschweig is one of Germany’s leading institutes of technology. It stands for strategic and performance-oriented thinking and acting, relevant research, committed teaching, and the successful transfer of knowledge and technologies to the economy and society. We consistently advocate for family friendliness and equal opportunities.

Our research focuses are mobility, engineering for health, metrology, and city of the future. Strong engineering and natural sciences are our core disciplines. These are closely interconnected with economics, social and educational sciences and humanities. Our campus is located in the midst of one of the most research-intensive regions in Europe. We work successfully together with over 20 research institutions in our neighborhood as we do with our international partner universities.

The Division of Cryogenic Quantum Electronics, led by Prof. Dr. Oleksandr Dobrovolskiy, investigates fascinating physical phenomena governing the dynamics of magnetic and superconducting systems and develops quantum electronic devices based on these principles. Its research bridges materials science, experimental physics, electrical measurement science, and metrology. To strengthen the research group and advance its cutting-edge research in cryogenic quantum electronics, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d)
(EG13 TV-L, full time - fixed term)

with demonstrated expertise in experimental low-temperature physics.
The position is to be filled on a fixed-term basis for an initial period of 2 years. The successful applicant will be given the opportunity to pursue a further scientific qualification (habilitation).

Your tasks

- You will carry out research in the area of cryogenic and quantum electronics, with a focus on experiments at mK temperatures.
- You will apply for and work on research projects.
- You will perform measurements in a dilution refrigerator and other cryogenic setups, develop, build and optimize cryogenic measurement platforms.
- You will publish research findings in leading international journals and participate in national and international conferences.
- You will be involved in teaching at the University (preparation and implementation of courses as well as supervision of students’ work).

Your Qualifications

- You hold a completed university degree at Master’s level or equivalent, as well as a completed PhD in a field relevant to the position (e.g. physics, electrical engineering, materials science, or a related field), and ideally have postdoctoral research experience.
- You have experience with low-temperature experiments, ideally involving dilution refrigerators in the fields of superconductivity and/or magnetism, as well as good programming skills (e.g., Python, LabVIEW).
- You have knowledge of superconducting and/or magnetic devices, high-frequency and microwave engineering, nanotechnology, and/or quantum measurement techniques, or you are willing and able to acquire this expertise quickly.
- You have excellent English language skills; knowledge of German is desirable.
- You are flexible, can perform under pressure and work well in a team.

We offer

- work on exciting future-oriented research topics in an inspiring work environment as part of the university community
- A vibrant campus life in an international atmosphere with lots of intercultural offers and international cooperations
- Pay in accordance with the collective agreement TV-L (a special payment at the end of the year as well as a supplementary benefit in the form of a company pension, comparable to a company pension in the private sector) including 30 days' vacation per year
- flexible working and part-time options and a family-friendly university culture, awarded the "Family-friendly university" audit since 2007
- special continuing education programs for young scientists, a postdoc program, as well as other offerings from the Central Personnel Development Department and sports activities.

Further notes
We welcome applicants of all nationalities. At the same time, we encourage people with severe disabilities to apply. Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preference if they are equally qualified. Please attach a proof of disability to your application. We are also working on the fulfilment of the Central Equality Plan based on the Lower Saxony Equal Rights Act (Niedersächsisches Gleichberechtigungsgesetz—NGG) and strive to reduce under-representation in all areas and positions as defined by the NGG. Therefore, applications from women are particularly welcome in this case.
